description: Real-time Cost Tracking (Per-Model Pricing) and Agent Provider Presets - standalone modules with no dependencies on other Sprint 5 features
steps: Create src/nexus/models_router/pricing.py porting logic from /projects/sandbox/munder-difflin/src/main/pricing.ts. Include: ModelPrice frozen dataclass (input_per_m, output_per_m, cache_read_per_m, cache_write_per_m), price constants for Anthropic (OPUS/SONNET/HAIKU), OpenAI (GPT4O/GPT4O_MINI/O1), and Google Gemini families. Include normalize_model() that strips variant suffixes like [1m], price_for() that resolves model family by keyword matching with Sonnet fallback, TokenSplit dataclass, and estimate_cost_usd() function.
Update src/nexus/models_router/__init__.py to export the new pricing module classes (ModelPrice, TokenSplit, normalize_model, price_for, estimate_cost_usd).

Create tests/test_pricing.py with comprehensive tests: all model families resolve correctly, unknown/None falls back to Sonnet/DEFAULT_PRICE, normalize_model strips variant suffixes, estimate_cost_usd computes correct values for known token splits, edge cases (zero tokens, empty string model).

Create src/nexus/adapters/provider_presets.py porting from /projects/sandbox/munder-difflin/src/shared/agentProvider.ts. Include: AgentProviderID str enum (claude/codex/grok/kimi/antigravity/qwen/opencode/crush/pi/copilot/custom), AgentProviderPreset frozen dataclass with fields (id, label, default_command, auto_mode_flag, supports_model, model_flag, hive_aware, can_receive_inbox, hook_bridge, recommended_orchestrator_model, resume_flag, install_command, docs_url, non_interactive_env dict), PROVIDER_PRESETS dict mapping all 11 providers, get_preset() with fallback to Claude.
Update src/nexus/adapters/__init__.py to export AgentProviderID, AgentProviderPreset, get_preset, PROVIDER_PRESETS.

Create tests/test_provider_presets.py with tests: all 11 providers exist in PROVIDER_PRESETS, each preset has required fields (id, label, default_command, auto_mode_flag), get_preset returns correct preset for each ID, get_preset with unknown falls back to Claude, key metadata values verified for claude/codex/antigravity presets.
acceptance_criteria: python3.12 -m pytest tests/test_pricing.py passes with all tests green
python3.12 -m pytest tests/test_provider_presets.py passes with all tests green
ModelPrice dataclass contains input_per_m, output_per_m, cache_read_per_m, cache_write_per_m fields
Price tables cover Anthropic (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku), OpenAI (GPT-4o/mini/o1), and Google Gemini
price_for resolves model family with keyword matching and Sonnet fallback
estimate_cost_usd correctly computes cost from TokenSplit
All 11 provider presets defined with full metadata
get_preset() lookup works with fallback to Claude for unknown IDs
